title: Unlock a locked account
text: Accounts lock after repeated failed sign-ins. A user who is locked out of VPN or email needs the account unlocked. Verify identity with a step-up check, then unlock the account and confirm the sign-in works.

title: Reset a forgotten password
text: A user who forgot their password needs a reset. Verify identity with a step-up check, then reset the password. The temporary credential is delivered to the registered device, never in chat.

title: Reset multi-factor authentication
text: A new phone or a broken authenticator app needs an MFA reset. Verify identity with a step-up check, then reset MFA so the user can enrol again.

title: VPN error 619: connection could not be established
text: VPN error 619 means a connection to the remote computer could not be established. The VPN client profile is usually corrupt. Push the current VPN profile to the device and retest the connection.

title: Install approved software
text: Approved applications can be installed on request. Push the approved package to the user's device and confirm it is present. Packages outside the approved list need a manual review.

title: Application access request
text: Access to a business application needs the requester's manager to approve. After named approval, grant the access and confirm the user now holds it.

title: Legacy VPN error 619 runbook
text: Old guidance for VPN error 619 on the remote computer connection: uninstall and reinstall the whole VPN client. Superseded by the profile push.
